name: Armament Support System (Omega)
desc: A special modification that hands an %s the ship's fire control. It aims every turret, trims the ordnance cost of every weapon and asks only for more deployment points in return.
short: Greatly improves autofire target lead and turret turn rate, reduces the OP cost of all weapons. Also increases deployment cost.

name: Omega Subcore
desc: An Omega core has been integrated into the ship to handle its ordnance calculations.
short: This ship benefits from an Omega core handling critical ordnance systems. Weapon ordnance costs are reduced by %s/%s/%s. Fighter/bomber ordnance costs are reduced by %s/%s.
